notes.title: Katana Stances Now Added!
notes.content:
[b]Katana combat[/b] in Falling Limbs now features the following [b]kenjutsu stances:[/b]

[b]• 八相の構え[/b]
- Hassō no kamae
  - Eight Aspects Stance

[b]• 中段の構え[/b]
- Chudan no kamae
  - Mid Level Stance

[b]• 下段の構え[/b]
- Gedan no kamae
  - Low Level Stance

[b]• 脇の構え[/b]
- Waki no kamae
  - Side Stance

[b]• 胡蝶の構え[/b]
- Kochō no kamae
  - Butterfly Stance

[b]• 上段の構え[/b]
- Jodan no kamae
  - High Level Stance

Each stance has both a [b]light[/b] and [b]strong strike[/b] that can be triggered from it


Watch the [b]video[/b] and get the [b]latest updates[/b] first in the [b]Discord[/b]
